description: This file defines the absl::MockingBitGen class, a mock implementation of a Uniform Random Bit Generator (URBG) for use in testing with the Googletest framework. It provides mechanisms to mock random number generation functions, register mock behaviors, and invoke registered mocks, primarily for deterministic testing of random-based APIs within the Abseil library.

classes.name: MockingBitGen
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Uniform Random Bit Generator (URBG) for testing purposes, supporting mock registration and invocation of random functions.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random result by invoking the internal generator.

methods.name: RegisterMock
methods.description: Registers a mock function for a specific result type and argument tuple, keyed by a type identifier.

methods.name: InvokeMock
methods.description: Invokes a registered mock function based on the type identifier, arguments, and stores the result.
